# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

## cand_0001
- The "EMPTY SEED — create from scratch" banner conflicted with reality: policy/policy.md and tools/tools.py already existed (full tau2 airline seed). The banner cost investigation time. Suggest the harness only show the empty-seed banner when the capability dirs are actually empty.
- The action-trace feedback is labeled DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY, but for stalls (tasks 40/25) the decisive signal is "no write was ever called," which is only visible by loading the trace and seeing termination_reason=USER_STOP after a bare confirmation question. A one-line "agent made 0 write calls; episode ended on user STOP after a confirmation prompt" in the feedback would speed diagnosis.
